categories_thin: Retail shops (furniture, jewellery, florist, hardware, appliances, bikes, gifts): Piscataway retail is dominated by big-box chains (Walmart, Lowe's) that are excluded, so only ~22 independents were found.
Independent hotels: Piscataway lodging is chain product (Holiday Inn, Embassy Suites, Radisson, Home2), so nothing qualified.
Self storage: every facility found (CubeSmart, Extra Space, SecureSpace, modSTORAGE) is a national or regional chain, so none were listed.
Bike shops, toy stores and bookstores: none found in Piscataway itself; the closest independents are in New Brunswick and Edison.
Funeral homes: only one Piscataway funeral home exists (Piscataway Funeral Home) - the rest of the town's funeral business is in South Plainfield/New Brunswick.
Locksmiths, security installers and other group C trades were out of scope for this brief.
caveats: Yellow Pages, Superpages, Cylex, Manta, BBB, DexKnows, chamberofcommerce.com and localsolution.com returned 403/Cloudflare blocks from this machine; entries drawn from those sites come from search-result snippets and are marked 'one directory only'.

NJ Business Directory entries carry name, category and address only - no phone or website - so roughly 45 manufacturers/wholesalers have phone 'Unknown'. The triage team should confirm each before outreach.
Several NJ Business Directory listings look stale (e.g. Jevic Transportation, Sunoco Refining & Marketing, Raceway Petroleum) and were deliberately left out of the main list.

Franchise/branded entries (Sir Speedy, Signarama, SpeedPro, Goddard School, The Learning Experience, KinderCare, Abbey Carpet) are kept only because the brief says to include when unsure; triage will probably drop them.
Group D overlaps group C for auto repair; four auto shops were included and flagged rather than dropped.

Duplicate suspects to merge at triage: Design & Molding Svc vs Montrose Molders Corp (25 Howard St); Helm US Chemical vs Helm New York (1110 Centennial Ave); PALS vs UniQ Prep (1629 Stelton Rd); National Manufacturing vs S.S. White Aerospace (151 Old New Brunswick Rd).
data_gaps: Overpass/OpenStreetMap API was unreachable (connection aborted, then HTTP 406) - no OSM cross-check of shops was possible.
The Township of Piscataway publishes no loadable licensed-business or economic-development directory, so the municipality's own list could not be used.
Google Maps returned a limited, non-paginating result set in this session (about 8 results per query), so map coverage per category is partial.
Yahoo Local 'Piscataway' category pages mix in businesses from a wide radius and often omit street addresses; only clearly Piscataway entries were kept and some addresses remain 'Unknown'.
No Piscataway-specific chamber of commerce directory was reachable; the Middlesex County Regional Chamber directory is county-wide and was not parsed for town members.
Dozens of further manufacturers are listed by D&B under Piscataway but the pages were not loadable, so that tail is only partly covered.
